headline: 3 US Solar Stocks Investors May Want To Watch After EnergyRe’s $815 Million Deal
summary: Institutional money just wrote an US$815m check to energyRe for five utility-scale solar projects, and that kind of commitment tends to ripple far beyond one developer. When 25-year power contracts and 360 MW of new capacity lock in, suppliers, grid operators, and competing solar developers all feel the pull. This article walks through three U.S. solar focused stocks exposed to that same trend and explains why their setups now deserve a closer look. The three stocks below are just a starting...

headline: AES Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of The AES Corporation (NYSE: AES) declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.17595 per share payable on November 13, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 30, 2026.
